description: Banner-style stock graphic for house cleaning services: a teal plastic caddy holding cleaning supplies (green spray bottle, white bottles, sponge) beside a small potted plant on a wooden surface, with a softly lit room behind. description: Screenshot of a U.S. Department of Justice website press release dated Monday, December 16, 2019: a statement by Attorney General William P. Barr on the departure of Principal Associate Deputy Attorney General Edward O'Callaghan. Barr praises O'Callaghan's service, including his time as a prosecutor in the Southern District of New York and as Acting Deputy Attorney General. DOJ seal and site navigation visible at top; press release number 19-1397.
text: THE UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT of JUSTICE. ABOUT. OUR AGENCY. PRIORITIES. NEWS. RESOURCES. CAREER. Home » Office of Public Affairs » News. JUSTICE NEWS. Department of Justice. Office of Public Affairs. FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE. Monday, December 16, 2019. Statement by Attorney General William P. Barr on the Departure of Principal Associate Deputy Attorney General Edward O'Callaghan. Attorney General William P. Barr issued the following statement:. 'Ed is one of the most highly regarded lawyers at the Department of Justice. His dedication and tireless commitment to the work of the Department is second to none. Ed possesses a rare combination of sharp intellect, common sense, and sound judgment – traits that served him well from his time as a prosecutor in the Southern District of New York to his service at the highest levels of the Department, including as Acting Deputy Attorney General. We were lucky to have him at the heart of the leadership team at DOJ. He will be greatly missed.'. Component(s):. Office of the Attorney General. Press Release Number:. 19-1397.

description: Screenshot of a verified @realDonaldTrump tweet dated April 24, 2019. Trump claims the Mueller Report, which he characterizes as written by 'Angry Democrats and Trump Haters' with $35,000,000 behind it, 'didn't lay a glove on me,' declares 'I DID NOTHING WRONG,' and says that if Democrats tried to impeach he would first head to the U.S. Supreme Court; the tweet cuts off mid-thread.
text: Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. Follow. The Mueller Report, despite being written by Angry Democrats and Trump Haters, and with unlimited money behind it ($35,000,000), didn't lay a glove on me. I DID NOTHING WRONG. If the partisan Dems ever tried to Impeach, I would first head to the U.S. Supreme Court. Not only....... 5:10 AM - 24 Apr 2019. 17,659 Retweets 68,219 Likes.
flags: Tweet's characterizations of the Mueller Report and its cost are Trump's claims, presented as documented, not endorsed

description: Dark-background graphic combining a handwritten-style caption with a scatter plot. The caption claims Trump and #QAnon have posted on a '[Zero Delta]' 36 times. The chart plots number of Q posts against minutes from a Q post to the next Trump tweet (0-20), with a spike of 36 at zero minutes, and annotation text asserting this is statistical evidence Trump coordinates his tweets with Q posts. The claim is a QAnon community 'zero delta' proof graphic, not a verified analysis.

description: Composite of two annotated Twitter screenshots. Top: a tweet by account 'I E T' (@Incarcerated_ET) arguing Trump has not been impeached because the House can only vote for impeachment and removal requires a Senate or 'Supreme Court trial' that 'Will. Not. Happen.'; a red box highlights 'Donald J. Trump Retweeted'. Bottom: the same account's profile page with a WWG1WGA-watermarked U.S. Capitol reflecting-pool banner and a bio line of a Q symbol, U.S. flag, cross, and frog (Pepe) emoji plus 'Q+', with red boxes around the Q and Q+ — presented as Trump amplifying a QAnon account. Profile photo shows a man and woman who are private individuals.
text: Donald J. Trump Retweeted. I E T @Incarcerated_ET · 3h. Trump has not been impeached. The house can't impeach. They can only vote for impeachment. Then the senate trial. Or. Supreme Court trial. BOTH have to vote to impeach Trump before he is actually removed from office. Which. Will. Not. Happen. WWG1WGA. I E T. @Incarcerated_ET. Q Q+. Follow. Joined November 2019. 954 Following 25.9K Followers.
flags: Tweet's claim that a Supreme Court trial is part of impeachment is constitutionally inaccurate; carried as the account's claim
